title: SDK fallback interoperability testbed + onboarding flow for low-latency SMBs
creator: Aisha Raman
description: Run a targeted product experiment and create an internal testbed ("Switchboard") that measures the real integration friction when customers implement SDK-based model fallbacks. Focus on SMB mobile-first use cases where latency and small binary size matter. Deliverables: test harness, onboarding playbook, instrumentation for SDK telemetry, and a sales-facing one-pager summarizing switching costs and UX failure modes.
success_metrics: Compute: median end-to-end SDK integration time < 90 minutes for a new dev
Engineering friction: average LOC to add fallback < 40 lines
Runtime: median token-latency delta for fallback model < 25% increase
Retention signal: 20% uplift in trial apps adopting fallback in next 90 days
Sales: one-pager used in 3 outbound SMB pilots within 30 days
proposed_experiment_plan: Build Switchboard harness to run parallel requests against primary and fallback model variants using the SDKs (node, python, android)
Define three SMB workloads: chat assistant (short context), search-rewrite (200-400 tokens), and summarization (500-800 tokens)
Automate integration steps and measure time-to-first-successful-call and developer errors in sandbox
Collect SDK telemetry: startup size, cold-start latency, token throughput, error classes (auth, schema mismatch, unexpected field)
Run A/B onboarding flows with 10 developer testers to capture qualitative UX notes
tasks: ENG: scaffold Switchboard harness and CI run (ENG-23145)
DX: add SDK telemetry hooks and consent flow
PM: write onboarding playbook and one-pager for sales
Design: create minimal UX checklist for SDK error handling
Research: recruit 10 SMB developers for 2-week probe
Analyze: build dashboard with token-latency and LOC metrics

decisions: Switchboard will run against model pairings: default-hosted-large -> quantized-compact fallback (to simulate common enterprise fallback pattern)
Metrics will prioritize developer time-to-integration and runtime delta rather than raw model quality for initial pilot
Do not include Dedicated private deployment variants in phase 1 to keep scope tight
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: telemetry may expose PII in sample prompts — Mitigation: scrub all prompts and require tester consent
Risk: android emulator cold-start not representative — Mitigation: include a small set of physical device runs from internal lab
Risk: SDK changes during experiment window — Mitigation: freeze SDK test branch and document compatibility delta
